chapter: Fellow musicians: Kirk, Bunk, Parker, McShann
title: Lovett and McShann; Lovett never ran around
summary: McShann told Lovett he wanted him as drummer, but Lovett never played with him and always went home to Tilly.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: He and his lovely wife, Maryann. Baby, what do you know about Jay? You must know a lot about him. Did you ever play for Jay?
No, never played for Jay. He always -- he wanted me, though, (inaudible). He'd tell me, he'd say, 'If anything ever
Who was he using, Gus Johnson in those days, I guess?
Yeah, Gus, and he's told me that since Paul has been working with him.
Yeah, he tells me that right now.
Well, you're a fabulous drummer, everybody know that, Baby.
He says, 'You're my drummer'. I say, 'Well I'm ready'. I never run with Jay, you know.
Well, you know, I don't think you ran with many people, Baby. Really, I think you went home every night afterwards.
That's right. I didn't do much running, not very much running. Still, I don't do much running.
